description: React component for canceling a booking, including UI elements, state management, and API interactions.

classes.name: InternalNotePresetsSelect
classes.description: A React component for selecting internal note presets with optional 'other' input.

methods.name: handleSelectChange
methods.description: Handles change in the internal note preset selection, toggling 'other' input visibility.

methods.description: Retrieves app-specific metadata from eventTypeMetadata based on appId.

methods.name: autoChargeNoShowFee

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Performs the booking cancellation API call, handles response, and triggers related events.
